# pIcŧU/Re (VoltFrame)

> Community photos of EV charging stations and sockets in Portugal, with one stable static photo link per station and per socket, keyed by the official NAP Portugal (MOBI.E) codes.

Pages are in European Portuguese, with English under /en/. Station and socket data come from NAP Portugal (MOBI.E), matched to OpenStreetMap, and are refreshed daily. Photo uploads are not open yet, so most static links still return 404.

## Pages

- [Station page](https://voltframe.ocarroeletrico.com/en/stations/EZC-AMD-00051): `/en/stations/{station id}` in English, `/postos/{station id}` in Portuguese.
- Socket lookup: `/en/sockets/{EVSE code}` (or `/tomadas/{EVSE code}`) redirects to the station page, anchored on that socket. The code works with or without the `*` (`PT*EZC*E*AMD*00051*1` or `PTEZCEAMD000511`).

## API

Read-only JSON, open CORS, no key.

- `GET /api/v1/stations/{station id}`: the station, its operator, address, coordinates, OSM element and sockets.
- `GET /api/v1/evses/{EVSE code}`: the socket and its station. 300 with `candidates` when the NAP lists the same code at more than one station, 404 when unknown.

## Static photo links

- `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/{station id}.jpg` (1024 px), `.thumb.jpg` (400 px), `.full.jpg` (2048 px).
- Sockets use the EVSE code without the `*`: `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/PTEZCEAMD000511.jpg`.
- The link never changes; the photo behind it can. 404 until the station or socket has a main photo.
